comment: Accepted audits of rule 2 of tools/check-docs.mjs. Each one was accepted before the rule refused a fenced block with no language or in text, and an audit is never edited again, so its blocks are history. Do not add an entry for a new document: a document points at code by path, and the one allowed block is a shell command.
